'''Marc Gasol Sáez''' (born [[January 29]], [[1985]], 2.15 m (7 ft 1 in)) is a [[Spanish people|Spanish]] professional [[basketball]] player for [[Akasvayu Girona]]. He is the younger brother of [[NBA]] player [[Pau Gasol]].

Gasol played [[high school]] basketball for the [[Lausanne Collegiate School]] in [[Memphis, Tennessee]], and was part of the [[Spain national basketball team|Spanish team]] which won the [[FIBA World Championship]] in 2006.
